PR surface: Source +30, Tests +143. Total +173 across 4 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: current main unconditionally runs persisted-key cleanup in Promise.finally after rename and delete RPCs. The contributor has not supplied a real current-main browser reproduction, so the observed proof remains source- and mock-based.

target.title: fix(ui): preserve sidebar collapsed state when group rename/delete fails
target.body:
Closes #105974

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users renaming or deleting a custom session group from the Control UI sidebar would still lose or rewrite that group's collapsed preference when the Gateway rejected the operation. The group remained on the server, but the sidebar treated the mutation as if it had succeeded and corrupted locally persisted navigation state.

## Why This Change Was Made

Collapsed-section cleanup for group rename/delete ran in `Promise.finally`, so it always ran after both success and rejection. The handlers now update collapsed keys only on successful Gateway completion and leave local storage unchanged when the RPC rejects. No new config, no migration, and no change to successful rename/delete behavior.

Fix quality: compatibility — browser preference follows confirmed Gateway mutations only; performance — same one-shot local storage write on success; usability — failed group edits no longer expand groups unexpectedly after reload; security — no trust-boundary change.

## User Impact

After a failed group rename or delete (network error, permission, or other Gateway rejection), the sidebar keeps the existing collapsed/expanded preference for that group. Successful rename still remaps the collapsed key; successful delete still removes it.

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS (agent-solo focused Vitest; Crabbox bypass)

**CS follow-up round (this push):**
1. Merged latest `main` into the PR branch to clear dirty/conflicting merge state (CS rank-up #1). Live GitHub now reports `mergeable=true`.
2. Routed group rename/delete rejections through `sessions.state.error` (same publish surface as patch/delete) so Sessions page callout feedback is preserved after success-only collapsed-key handlers (CS risk / bestSolution visible error path).
3. Focused regression re-run after merge + error-path change:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/components/app-sidebar.test.ts -t "group mutation collapsed"
✓ keeps collapsed keys when group rename is rejected
✓ rewrites collapsed keys only after group rename succeeds
✓ keeps collapsed keys when group delete is rejected
✓ drops collapsed keys only after group delete succeeds
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  4 passed | 45 skipped (49)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts -t "publishes state.error when group"
✓ publishes state.error when group rename is rejected
✓ publishes state.error when group delete is rejected
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  2 passed | 23 skipped (25)
```

Static: `git diff --check` clean on touched paths. Head SHA: `776818dc54b4`.

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: rejected `sessions.groups.rename` / `sessions.groups.delete` no longer rewrite `openclaw:sidebar:sessions:collapsed-sections` keys; rejections publish `sessions.state.error` for the Sessions page callout (same surface as other session mutations).
- Environment: local macOS, openclaw checkout at commit `776818dc54b4`, Vitest jsdom Control UI harness + session capability unit tests.
- Current-main contrast: on main, both handlers used `.finally()`, so a rejected rename still moved `category:<old>` → `category:<new>` and a rejected delete still removed `category:<group>` from local storage even though the Gateway group remained. Group rename/delete also did not publish `state.error` on rejection.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. Seed localStorage collapsed set to `["category:Alpha"]`.
  2. Mount sidebar with custom group `Alpha`, `connected=true`.
  3. Open group menu → Rename to `Beta` with `groupsRename` rejecting; assert storage still `["category:Alpha"]`.
  4. Same path with rename resolving; assert storage becomes `["category:Beta"]`.
  5. Open group menu → Delete with `groupsDelete` rejecting; assert storage still `["category:Alpha"]`.
  6. Same path with delete resolving; assert storage `[]`.
  7. Capability-level: `groupsRename`/`groupsDelete` reject → `sessions.state.error` is set and the promise rejects (Sessions page reads this for the danger callout).
  Commands:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/components/app-sidebar.test.ts -t "group mutation collapsed"`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts -t "publishes state.error when group"`
- Evidence after fix: all six cases passed (see Evidence terminal output). Reject paths leave collapsed JSON byte-for-byte as `["category:Alpha"]` and publish mutation errors; success paths apply key rewrite/removal only.
- Control check: success cases still migrate/remove keys; empty sidebar catch matches other session mutation handlers once the capability publishes errors.
- Observed result after fix: rejected group mutations no longer corrupt persisted collapsed-section preferences; merge conflicts against main are cleared.
- What was not tested: live browser against a real Gateway process that rejects group RPCs (agent-solo path used jsdom harness + mocked Gateway client; no live Control UI recording this round).

## AI disclosure

This fix was authored with AI assistance (Grok). Human operator ran the automated find→fix→PR pipeline in auto mode; CS follow-up auto-fix merged main, added capability error publish + unit proof.
